newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ASTROS PLACE OF DEREK BELL ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ASTROS PLACE OF DEREK BELL ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: The Houston Astros on Friday placed starting centre fielder Derek Bell on the 15-day disabled list with a hematoma in his left calf muscle.

An examination Thursday revealed the hematoma, which is a mass of coagulated blood. Bell was expected to undergo surgery to have the hematoma drained on Friday and the team said he will likely be sidelined three to four weeks.
Bell, 28, suffered the injury Tuesday night against the New York Mets when he fouled a pitch off his left calf.
James Mouton is the likely candidate to start in centre field in place of Bell, who was hitting .244 with two homers and 13 RBI in 37 games.
